nextReadySlice.title: Dry-run idempotency tests for the codemod CLI
failingProof: A failing proof shows repeated dry-run executions against the same fixture copy are not yet explicitly proven to return the same stable migration-diagnostics payload and artifact set.
A failing proof shows review-only codemod runs could still drift because of temp-path, ordering, or output-writing behavior even though apply-mode idempotency is already covered.
nextReadySlice.reviewGate: Stop for review if proving dry-run idempotency requires freezing timestamps, temp-paths, or artifact metadata in a way that changes the intended CLI contract.
